data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Book > Hotels, destination, dates, Search, sort by price lowest first) with the right parameters. It adds guest-setting and reserve steps that the true workflow lists only as optional, and it hard-codes the price sort instead of treating sort as a parameter. Even so, the steps are concrete enough to automate.
